name: hfro
description: Two read-only reviewers on Opus at high effort: a plan-advisor that must review every plan before files change and an advisor that must approve every change before it reaches you, enforced by hooks. /hfro:topadvisor uses Fable at high effort. Falls back to another model when the reviewer hits its limit.

fallback_model.title: Fallback model for the reviewers
fallback_model.description: Model the advisor and plan-advisor use when Opus is at its usage or rate limit or unavailable: fable, opus, sonnet, haiku, or off (no fallback).

fallback_effort.title: Fallback effort
fallback_effort.description: Effort level for the fallback model: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.
